title: Preserve CSV rerun item evidence
summary: Keeps active CSV rerun evidence visible when the backend current-work item is the placeholder None.
reason: A placeholder current-work item hid the latest staged CSV filename even though bounded stdout evidence identified it.
behavior_before: CSV rerun Home status treated the truthy placeholder None as a real current item and rendered it instead of the latest CSV staging evidence.
behavior_after: An exact case-insensitive None placeholder falls back to current-import or last-imported CSV evidence, while genuine backend labels remain preferred.
manual_validation: RED: test_webview_browser_home_live_state_smoke failed because placeholder None hid the staged CSV item
python -m unittest targeted WebView contracts/browser suite - passed (119 tests)
rollback_plan: Revert the CSV display-item fallback and its focused browser assertions; this only affects Home display text.
notes:
Treat placeholder CSV current-work labels as absent so stdout evidence can identify the staged item.
Cover CSV stdout fallback when backend supplies placeholder None while preserving genuine current-work labels.
